name: Spinner
summary: A small spinning ring for a short wait of unknown length.
description: Use it next to a text label inside a role="status" element. For work with a known length, use a progress bar; for a loading button, use aria-busy on the button instead.

classes.name: v-spinner
classes.description: The ring, 1.25rem by default, in the accent colour. Set --v-spinner-size or color to change it.

classes.name: v-spinner-lg
classes.description: Large, 2.25rem, for a whole panel or page loading.

a11y: Mark the spinner aria-hidden="true" and put a text label next to it in a role="status" element, so the wait is announced.
Under prefers-reduced-motion the ring stops turning; the text label still tells people something is happening.
Remove the spinner (and the status text) when loading ends, or change the text to say it is done.
